title_zh: 按证据修订古城展品说明

scenario.label_zh: 限定古城器物说明的证据范围
scenario.goal_zh: 根据目录资料保留器物发现地点，删除未经证实的普遍饮食结论并补充出处编号

context_zh: 两名博物馆教育志愿者核对虚构古城展品的说明，不把单件器物代表为整个文明。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: This label says the bowl shows what everyone in the civilization ate. Isn't that too much to claim from one object?

sentences.speaker: Hugh
sentences.text: Yes. The catalogue only says bowls of this shape are commonly found in houses in the excavated district.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Does it tell us what was served in them?

sentences.speaker: Hugh
sentences.text: Not for this bowl. The contents haven't been identified.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Then I'll describe where this type was found and remove the claim about everyone's diet.

sentences.speaker: Hugh
sentences.text: Good. Include the catalogue number so visitors can trace the information.
